2026/04/12 Update: been a while, apologize for the lack of responses. but I was busy with IRL stuff and I didn't really want to make any posts until there was some progress, which leads to this update because...

Good news: my SubscribeStar Adult account was approved. you can visit the page and check it out, unfortunetly you won't be able to subscribe just yet, which leads to the bad news.

Bad news: it will take me a few weeks to start uploading, hopefully sometime in the middle of May. I know some of you are looking forward to new uploads, but there is a good reason why I can't start posting just yet (which I can't explain for now), so you will have to wait a little bit more, and I appreciate your understanding.

Besides that, I will most likely come back to Patreon, but will only have my Daz3D stuff.
